ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Flooded Canyon
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
FLOOD_CANYON_BIOME_1 (owner ruling, 2026-09-12, verbatim on the filing event: the flood-witness work restructures into its own standalone biome mod — canyons that get periodically flooded, flooding as one of its events, the chime warning mechanic included). A dry canyon biome and its own hazard kit, fully generalized: it names no other franchise or campaign and is playable standalone on any generated RimWorld planet. It generalizes the mechanic sketched for a frozen campaign world's own canyon biome elsewhere in this repo (design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/the_cracked_lands.md) with zero campaign-specific content — no named factions, no lore proper nouns, nothing that names the source campaign.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it.
Ships three mechanics, every one togglable in Mod Settings (defaults = shipped behavior, MOD_OPTIONS_RETROFIT_1 doctrine):
1. The Flooded Canyon biome: a rare, hot, high-relief canyon country that inserts into worldgen via a rarity slider (0 = never generates, same "1-3 rare patches by default" pattern as the sibling Gelatinous Slime mod's own worker). 2. The flood cycle: each canyon-biome map (or, opted in, ANY map) carries its own clock to the next flood. A chime warning rings ahead of the water (the source sheet's "water chimes ring... tones rolling up through the stone ahead of any sound of water", generalized to a reused vanilla notification cue — no new audio commissioned for v1). Then the wall arrives: a footprint of the canyon floor floods for a set duration, at light and non-fatal hazard to anyone caught standing in it, and drains to real fertile soil once it recedes — "death, then soil" as an engine, not a set piece. Ground that has been EXCAVATED is not converted at all: the flood fills those cells through RimMandrake: FlowWorks, which owns depth and fill, and empties them again when it recedes. A dug channel, a pit or a superdeep excavation therefore survives a flood instead of being erased by it. 3. The soak: every cell the flood wets is handed to RimMandrake: Explosive Plant Growth (mandrake.rm.explosivegrowth) as SOAKED ground for the flood's duration plus a few days, so the wet floor swells, charges and blooms. That mod owns the growth and the terminal moments; it is an optional companion found by reflection — without it the flood still floods, chimes and leaves soil, and simply soaks nothing.
NOT in this mod (owned elsewhere, per the calling item's own boundary): the Utinni campaign's guaranteed first-witnessing quest beat (FLOOD_WITNESS_EVENT_1) and the plant-growth engine (EXPLOSIVE_PLANT_GROWTH_1, mandrake.rm.explosivegrowth) — both live outside it.
